import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";

});
const exampleNatFirewallSwitch = new tencentcloud.cfw.NatFirewallSwitch("example", {
    natInsId: example.then(example => example.id),

});

            .natInsId(example.id())
            .subnetId(example.datas()[0].subnetId())
            .enable(0)
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



CFW nat firewall switch can be imported using the natInsId#subnetId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cfw/natFirewallSwitch:NatFirewallSwitch example cfwnat-18d2ba18#subnet-ef7wyymr
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
